sources.entry: TypeScript: _NaivecoinStake: a tutorial for building a cryptocurrency with the Proof of Stake consensus_

summary.title: NaivecoinStake
summary.one_liner: A tutorial for building a simple cryptocurrency from scratch that uses Proof of Stake (minting) instead of Proof of Work (mining).
keywords: proof of work vs proof of stake
how to implement proof of stake
takeaways: NaivecoinStake is a fork of Lauri Hartikka's Naivecoin tutorial, with Proof of Work (mining) replaced by Proof of Stake (minting).
The author chose PoS because Proof of Work is criticized for high energy use and PoS is presented as an energy-efficient alternative.
The PoS implementation is very simple and the author states it is not suitable for production use.
The source is open, and the author invites contributions.
summary.summary: NaivecoinStake is a tutorial for building a cryptocurrency from scratch using the Proof of Stake consensus. It is a fork of Lauri Hartikka's Naivecoin tutorial, with the original Proof of Work mining replaced by Proof of Stake minting. The author states the PoS implementation is very simple, not intended for production, and that the source code is open for contributions.
